newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends easier in kerb trade, seen wea.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends easier in kerb trade, seen wea.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended at 42.10 to the dollar on Monday, after opening easier at 41.90, following higher demand for the US currency, dealers said.
"The dollar fell to attractive levels last weak prompting fresh buying today," dealer Owais Kalia said. "The dollar demand is likely to remain high in the coming days."

The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last fixed on May 23, was 40.3900/40.5920 to the dollar. The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed up at 4.0 percent from the previous close of 3.70. on Saturday. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
